risk: Unrepresentative training data under-represents darker skin tones
harm: Missed or late melanoma detection in under-represented patients
likelihood_severity_rationale: Melanoma is rare but lethal (severity 5); published audits repeatedly find skewed image archives (likelihood 4)
evidence_needed: Subgroup-stratified dataset audit with documented provenance
mitigation: Set minimum subgroup representation thresholds before training; source additional consented data where gaps exist
monitoring_indicator: Quarterly dataset composition report vs thresholds

risk: Label errors from single-annotator ground truth
harm: Model learns wrong decision boundary; systematic misclassification
likelihood_severity_rationale: Dermoscopic labels without histopathology confirmation are known to be noisy (likelihood 3); boundary errors affect many cases (severity 4)
evidence_needed: Proportion of labels with histopathology or expert consensus confirmation
mitigation: Use consensus or histopathology-confirmed labels for test set; record label source per image
monitoring_indicator: Percentage of test labels confirmed; tracked per release

risk: Annotator disagreement on borderline lesions is discarded silently
harm: Model appears more certain than the underlying evidence justifies
likelihood_severity_rationale: Borderline cases are common in dermatology (likelihood 4); harm is mainly overconfidence rather than direct injury (severity 3)
evidence_needed: Inter-annotator agreement statistics and disagreement log
mitigation: Retain disagreement as an uncertainty flag; route disagreed cases to clinician review in deployment
monitoring_indicator: Disagreement rate reported per data batch

risk: Class imbalance drives the model to under-detect minority classes
harm: False negatives concentrated in rare but serious classes
likelihood_severity_rationale: Imbalance is present by construction in skin-lesion archives (likelihood 5); a missed melanoma can be fatal (severity 5)
evidence_needed: Per-class sensitivity on a held-out test set with confidence intervals
mitigation: Class weighting or balanced sampling evaluated as a controlled experiment; report worst-class recall
monitoring_indicator: Per-class recall in every model release note

risk: Data leakage between train and test via multiple images of one patient
harm: Inflated validation results that do not generalise
likelihood_severity_rationale: Multiple images per patient are common (likelihood 3); decisions made on inflated evidence can harm at scale (severity 5)
evidence_needed: Patient-level split audit and duplicate check
mitigation: Enforce patient-level splits and near-duplicate checks in the data pipeline
monitoring_indicator: Split audit signed off before each training run

risk: No external validation on data from another site or device
harm: Performance collapses silently at a new clinic
likelihood_severity_rationale: Domain shift between devices and sites is well documented (likelihood 4); undetected collapse affects every patient at that site (severity 5)
evidence_needed: External validation report on at least one independent site dataset
mitigation: Require external validation before deployment at any new site; publish site-specific metrics
monitoring_indicator: External validation status per site; go-live gate

risk: Subgroup performance reported without uncertainty intervals
harm: Small-sample noise is read as proof of fairness or of bias
likelihood_severity_rationale: Subgroups are often small (likelihood 4); wrong conclusions misdirect remediation (severity 3)
evidence_needed: Subgroup metrics with Wilson or bootstrap confidence intervals
mitigation: Report intervals alongside point estimates; predefine minimum subgroup sizes for claims
monitoring_indicator: Evaluation report checklist item verified per release

risk: Procured model version differs from the validated version
likelihood_severity_rationale: Version drift is uncommon with change control (likelihood 2) but bypasses all prior assurance (severity 5)
evidence_needed: Version hash matched against the validation record at installation
mitigation: Contract requires version pinning and re-validation on any model update
monitoring_indicator: Installed version hash logged and checked monthly

risk: Automation bias: clinicians accept model output without scrutiny
harm: Clinician skill and independent judgement erode; errors pass unchecked
affected_group: Patients whose clinician over-relies on the tool
likelihood_severity_rationale: Automation bias is a replicated human-factors finding (likelihood 4); a passed-through false negative can be fatal (severity 4)
evidence_needed: Human-factors study measuring override and agreement rates
mitigation: Show model uncertainty; require recorded clinician judgement before showing model output in high-risk cases
monitoring_indicator: Override rate and blind-first-judgement compliance audited quarterly

risk: System framed as diagnosis rather than triage support
harm: Patients are reassured or escalated on an unvalidated basis
likelihood_severity_rationale: Scope creep in busy clinics is plausible (likelihood 3); autonomous use exceeds the evidence base (severity 5)
evidence_needed: Documented intended-use statement shown in the user interface
mitigation: Label the tool 'prioritisation support only - not a diagnosis' in UI, training and SOPs
monitoring_indicator: Intended-use compliance spot checks; incident log review

risk: False negatives in triage delay urgent referral
harm: Melanoma progresses during a delayed pathway
likelihood_severity_rationale: Some false negatives are inevitable (likelihood 3); delay in melanoma materially worsens prognosis (severity 5)
evidence_needed: Sensitivity at the deployed threshold with a defined safety net
mitigation: Set the operating threshold for high sensitivity; safety-net all low-priority cases with routine clinician review
monitoring_indicator: False-negative audit of a sample of low-priority cases monthly

risk: False positives flood the urgent referral pathway
harm: Clinic capacity is consumed and genuinely urgent cases wait longer
affected_group: All referred patients and clinic staff
likelihood_severity_rationale: Lowering thresholds raises false positives predictably (likelihood 4); harm is delay and anxiety rather than direct injury (severity 3)
evidence_needed: Positive predictive value and referral volume at the deployed threshold
mitigation: Monitor referral volume against capacity; adjust threshold only through governance sign-off
monitoring_indicator: Weekly referral volume and PPV dashboard

risk: Performance drift as cameras and populations change over time
harm: Gradual undetected degradation of triage quality
likelihood_severity_rationale: Devices are replaced and populations shift routinely (likelihood 4); slow drift evades one-off validation (severity 4)
evidence_needed: Rolling performance audit on sampled clinician-confirmed outcomes
mitigation: Schedule rolling audits; define drift thresholds that trigger re-validation
monitoring_indicator: Drift metric reported monthly; trigger log

risk: No incident-reporting route for suspected AI-related harm
harm: Harm recurs because nobody aggregates the signal
likelihood_severity_rationale: Without a route, under-reporting is the default (likelihood 3); repeated harm is preventable once visible (severity 4)
evidence_needed: Incident taxonomy and reporting route tested with frontline staff
mitigation: Add an AI-specific category to the existing incident system; review monthly
monitoring_indicator: Number and outcome of AI-flagged incidents per month

risk: Dermoscopic images and metadata are re-identifiable
harm: Privacy breach and loss of patient trust
likelihood_severity_rationale: Access controls reduce likelihood (2); images plus metadata can identify individuals so impact is high (severity 5)
evidence_needed: Data protection impact assessment and access log review
mitigation: Minimise metadata; encrypt at rest; role-based access; no images in public repositories
monitoring_indicator: Access log review quarterly; DPIA refreshed annually

risk: Model or training data sent to an unapproved external API
harm: Uncontrolled disclosure of patient data to a third party
likelihood_severity_rationale: Requires a process failure (likelihood 2) but disclosure is irreversible (severity 5)
mitigation: Block unapproved endpoints; contract and audit any processor before use
monitoring_indicator: Data-flow map reviewed at every system change

risk: No named owner when the system contributes to a harmful decision
harm: Accountability gaps delay learning and redress
likelihood_severity_rationale: Shared clinician-developer-vendor responsibility is ambiguous by default (likelihood 3); unresolved accountability compounds harm (severity 4)
evidence_needed: Named accountable roles in a signed governance document
mitigation: Publish a responsibility matrix covering developer deployer and clinician duties before go-live
monitoring_indicator: Responsibility matrix reviewed at governance board twice yearly

risk: Model withdrawn without checking dependent pathways
harm: Referral pathways break or silently revert to inconsistent manual triage
likelihood_severity_rationale: Withdrawal is planned and rare (likelihood 2); disruption is recoverable if mapped (severity 3)
evidence_needed: Dependency map of pathways using the model output
mitigation: Maintain a dependency map; require an exit plan with pathway owners notified in advance
monitoring_indicator: Exit plan tested before any withdrawal decision
